2540 *ōccha 'small, thin, mean'.
    Pk. uccha- 'low, mean'; Dm. ū́čha, ū́ča 'little'; Kal. učī́k 'light (of weight)'; Phal. účo 'a little'; S. ocho 'paltry, mean', L. (Shahpur) ochā, awāṇ. hochā; P. ochā 'light, vain, absurd'; WPah. bhal. hoccho 'mean, low'; Ku. occho, wac° 'mean, contemptible, arrogant'; Or. ocha 'small, mean, exhausted'; Bhoj. ōch 'mean'; H. ochā 'empty, small, silly'; OG. uchaü 'less', G. ochũ 'deficient, inferior'; M. os 'desolate, depopulated', osā m. 'empty space in a cornfield'; — M. otsā light, mean, deficient' ← H. or G.
    Addenda: *ōccha- [~ *hōccha- Add²; cf. WPah.kṭg. ókkhɔ 'small' ~ *hōkkha- Add²]: S.kcch. ochū̃ keṇū 'to lessen'.
